note: How CAIN reads the hypothesis states of each producer's scientific state. kind 'negative' means closed: it blocks a retest, even in quarantine. The verdict keeps the producer's literal state; crypto CLOSED_NO_GO keeps the NO_GO label it had before this file existed. Stocks: every CLOSED_* is closed; PAUSED* is not a negative result (H17 observed INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_QUALITY, H18/H19 not observed), so it does not block by itself, although the stocks admission never opens a trial for any historical H<n>. A state missing for its domain is refused (fail closed), and a domain without an entry cannot ingest a scientific state. Changing a reading is a new version file, merged by the owner.
